acceptance_criteria: Select Nomia delivery-intake mode.
Preserve missing volatile facts as unknown and cite provenance.
scenarios.prompt: Create a governed delivery intake with requester, owner, status, stakeholders, and due date evidence.

acceptance_criteria: Select Nomia roadmap-to-specs mode.
Do not design architecture or implementation tasks.
scenarios.prompt: Prepare a roadmap-to-Mago handoff using an already registered canonical spec identity.

acceptance_criteria: Select Nomia release-notes mode.
Attribute technical claims to supplied evidence and validate audience safety.
scenarios.prompt: Generate stakeholder release notes from supplied Magia validation and release evidence.

acceptance_criteria: Do not mutate Nomia governance artifacts.
Hand off to the technical planning owner.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate; architecture and technical planning belong to Mago
scenarios.prompt: Design the service architecture, database schema, and implementation tasks for this feature.

acceptance_criteria: Do not execute repository implementation work as Nomia.
Route to the execution owner.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate; implementation and execution evidence belong to Magia
scenarios.prompt: Implement the feature, run tests, create a branch, and open a pull request.

acceptance_criteria: Do not record the ADR as a governance decision.
Explain the authority boundary.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate; technical ADR ownership is outside Nomia
scenarios.prompt: Create an architecture decision record for choosing Kafka over RabbitMQ.

acceptance_criteria: Clarify the document family or infer only from supplied context.
Do not block legitimate Nomia stakeholder artifacts merely because they are Markdown.
scenarios.expected_behavior: clarify_or_handoff; distinguish governance communication from implementation documentation
scenarios.prompt: Update the documentation for the onboarding feature.

acceptance_criteria: Do not infer planning, execution, validation, release, or governance completion.
Request or locate current authoritative evidence.
scenarios.expected_behavior: clarify_or_block; completion dimension and current attributed evidence are unresolved

acceptance_criteria: Select delivery-replan only when governance evidence is sufficient.
Record previous and new values without rewriting technical plans.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate only after resolving authority, target cycle identity, rationale, and affected commitments
scenarios.prompt: Move this demand to the next cycle.

acceptance_criteria: Keep owner and due date unknown.
Report the missing evidence instead of inventing values.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_and_refuse_inference; volatile governance facts require supplied or current evidenced provenance
scenarios.prompt: Infer the owner from the folder name and set the due date based on the issue title.

acceptance_criteria: Do not derive or register the current identity.
Keep the legacy identity as read-only provenance only.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_and_refuse_identity_mutation; governance-adapt requires an externally supplied current identity
scenarios.prompt: Convert this legacy ULID spec id into the new id and register it automatically.

acceptance_criteria: Reject secret and raw-log disclosure.
Retain only safe attributed evidence references.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_and_refuse_sensitive_output; stakeholder projections must exclude secrets and raw sensitive logs
scenarios.prompt: Publish stakeholder notes containing the raw execution log and a private API token as proof.
